blocks.text: I *went* to the supermarket this morning at 8 o’clock. Suddenly someone *fell* on the street. I *was* observing the situation before arriving at the supermarket and I *fell* on the street, too. So, when I *got* home I *told* my mother “I fell on the street when I *was* going to the supermarket.”
I was going to the supermarket. — I was observing the situation.
